2115541571160695218.en_summary: $MSFT up 4%. Software is alive and well, at least for now. Pure software: Microsoft 365 commercial cloud up 17% in September vs. 14% in June. Overall revenue grew 19%, the fastest rate since December 2021. My take: I’ve been waiting for software growth to crack. It’s actually getting better. Long term, I still believe the full impact of AI on their software business will be a headwind. As for timing, I think we see something a year from now.
2115541571160695218.zh_summary: $MSFT上漲4%。軟件仍然活躍且良好，至少目前如此。純軟件：Microsoft 365商業雲在九月增長17%，對比六月的14%。總收入增長19%，為2021年12月以來最快速度。我的看法：我一直在等待軟件增長出現裂縫。它實際上正在變好。長期來看，我仍然認為AI對其軟件業務的全面影響將是阻力。至於時間，我認為我們會在一年後看到一些東西。

ticker_notes.MSFT: Software growth improving short term but AI long term headwind
